Confirmed. The body fails if the enable byte at +0x42a is unset, if selector 0x13 resolves to status 6 or 7, if the supplied nested provider is missing, or if its provider flag at +0xa2 is clear. It then gets player attribute 9, reads the provider halfword at +0x18, and succeeds only when the converted attribute plus that halfword equals 1; otherwise it returns 0xfffffffe (main_0119.c:10074-10134). The caller stores the result for a subsequent conditional path (main_0118.c:3241-3247). This supports a validation label while preserving uncertainty about the opaque context semantics.
